title: Deployment
description: A long-lived service the node-agent must keep running: image, command, published ports, replicas, resources, restart policy, healthcheck, and the environment it needs. This is the public contract between the OSS node-agent (which executes it, POST /v1/services) and any control plane (which decides tenancy, routing, and billing). Env VALUES are carried in the request but never written to node state — only env_keys are persisted.

schema_version.description: Contract version. Bump the major part on a breaking change.

service_id.description: Stable, DNS- and Docker-safe service identifier. The node derives container names as mo-svc-<service_id>-<replica>.

deployment_id.description: Opaque id of the deployment attempt (commit sha or ULID). Stamped on every container label for rollback and log correlation.

image.description: Container image reference. Prefer an immutable digest (repo@sha256:...) in production; a tag is allowed for local use.

command.description: Overrides the image ENTRYPOINT/CMD when present. Empty = use the image default.

replicas.description: Number of identical containers to run behind the service.

ports.description: Ports exposed by the container. host is optional; when omitted the node publishes an ephemeral port.

resources.description: Hard limits. Absent = node default; never unbounded on a shared node.

restart_policy.description: unless-stopped is the platform default: a crashed service restarts, but an operator stop survives a daemon restart.

healthcheck.description: Container-level liveness probe. The node reports healthy/unhealthy; the control plane decides whether to route traffic or roll back.

env.description: Non-secret configuration resolved by the caller. Values are passed to docker run and are NOT persisted to node state.

env_keys.description: Names the container needs. A value is taken from env, else from the node's own environment; the names (never the values) are persisted so a restart does not need the caller.

network.description: Container network to join. Services on the same network reach each other by container name; omit for the daemon default.

user.description: user[:group] or uid[:gid] the container runs as. The control plane is expected to require a non-root value.

labels.description: Extra labels stamped on the containers. mo.* keys are reserved by mini-ork and are ignored from this map.

status.description: Read-only, echoed by the node after create/restart/status. Never sent by the caller.
